svg.title: The week, hour by hour
svg.desc: A grid of seven days by twenty-four hours. Almost every hour is coloured: the model generating dominates the first three days, judge and test runs and waiting on CI dominate the last three.
svg.text: Each cell is one clock hour, coloured by what took most of its minutes across every agent (UTC-4).
